title: Omnipod Dash
symptom: User requests development to pull carb, bolus, and basal rate data from the Omnipod Dash into xDrip to automate the system and eliminate redundant data input.
cause: The BT communication of the Omnipod Dash has not been decoded, which prevents reading values from the pump and issuing commands.
evidence_quote: Issue with DASH right now is that the BT communication has not been decoded.
